**Clause E-17 of form HO-0304 (ed. 03-24):**  

> “Water damage resulting from the “sudden and accidental” discharge, rupture, or burst of a plumbing supply line within the dwelling.” — *Exclusion: No* (this exclusion does NOT apply; direct physical damage caused by water escaping a supply line that ruptures suddenly is covered, subject to the deductible. The cost to tear out and replace the failed section of the supply line itself is not covered.)[policy-docs__get_clause]
